prepared_effect.per_consumer_load_authorization_cost_bas: Measured one-process projection work; used as the explicit load/authorization proxy until persisted storage exists.
prepared_effect.work_measurement_basis: Summed preparation/projection counters for one disabled-cache independent process per required command family (strict, audit, no_new_debt, architecture_health, change_snapshot, topology, measure), with cold preparation derived only from independent preparation counters. The persisted comparison adds the same measured unavoidable projection/command work to its total. Cache miss/hit samples remain supplemental and are excluded from the comparable workload.

storage_bytes.reason: Prepared-state storage is not implemented; the bounded estimate is recorded separately.

io_operations.reason: Persisted prepared-state I/O does not exist before implementation; the bounded estimate is recorded separately.

allocated_bytes.reason: Prepared-state allocation is not isolated; the bounded estimate is recorded separately.

peak_managed_memory.reason: Prepared-state memory is not isolated; the bounded estimate is recorded separately.

storage_bound.basis: Deterministic workload-record envelope plus the largest representative profile payload; this is a pre-implementation serialized-state proxy.
storage_bound.uncertainty: 16-256 bytes per deterministic record and 0.25x-4x profile payload; replace with store instrumentation before implementation.

io_operations_bound.basis: One persisted write and one authorization/read minimum, with one metadata/read allowance per representative consumer.
io_operations_bound.uncertainty: The range covers one write plus one-to-two read/metadata operations per consumer until the store protocol is selected.

allocated_bytes_bound.basis: Serialized-state envelope with one additional encode/decode working copy.
allocated_bytes_bound.uncertainty: One-to-two state copies; implementation must replace this proxy with allocation measurement.

peak_managed_memory_bound.uncertainty: One-to-two state copies; excludes unrelated host memory and requires implementation instrumentation.

prepared_effect.scale_evidence_basis: Measured analysis-profile/v1 counters for small, medium, and large RealMsBuild workloads; each point runs one cache-disabled process for every representative command family (strict, audit, no_new_debt, architecture_health, change_snapshot, topology, measure) and separately measures its strict/audit projection counters as the scale-specific load/authorization proxy.

scale_evidence.label: small
scale_evidence.measurement_basis: Measured analysis-profile/v1 counters from one cache-disabled CLI process per command family plus scale-specific strict/audit projection counters for the load/authorization proxy.

scale_evidence.label: medium
scale_evidence.measurement_basis: Measured analysis-profile/v1 counters from one cache-disabled CLI process per command family plus scale-specific strict/audit projection counters for the load/authorization proxy.

scale_evidence.label: large
scale_evidence.measurement_basis: Measured analysis-profile/v1 counters from one cache-disabled CLI process per command family plus scale-specific strict/audit projection counters for the load/authorization proxy.

expected_effect.current_work_model: R x independent candidate preparation/fact work
expected_effect.target_work_model: one cold preparation + R x load/authorization + unavoidable projection/command work
expected_effect.memory_allocation_trade_off: Direct storage, I/O, allocation, and peak-memory measurements remain unavailable; bounded pre-implementation sensitivity ranges are recorded and must be replaced by store instrumentation.
expected_effect.cold_path_trade_off: The cold preparation remains a separate cost and is never counted as a cache hit.
expected_effect.success_threshold: Only authorize implementation when persisted reuse is at least 10% cheaper than the measured representative one-process alternative, the measured small/medium/large matrix is decision-capable, and resource bounds are available.
expected_effect.kill_criterion: Defer or route elsewhere when canonical equivalence, cache separation, or a representative crossover is not reproduced.
expected_effect.confidence: Expected effect and small/medium/large scaling are derived from measured analysis-profile counters; each scale point has a separately measured strict/audit load/authorization proxy, while the persisted store remains an explicit pre-implementation proxy.

decision.reason: Measured counter work shows persisted reuse is materially cheaper than the measured one-process alternative (52.0 % savings versus a 10.0 % threshold), with a strict break-even under the measured load-cost range.

prepared_effect.per_consumer_load_authorization_cost_bas: Measured one-process projection work; used as the explicit load/authorization proxy until persisted storage exists.
prepared_effect.work_measurement_basis: Summed preparation/projection counters for one disabled-cache independent process per required command family (strict, audit, no_new_debt, architecture_health, change_snapshot, topology, measure), with cold preparation derived only from independent preparation counters. The persisted comparison adds the same measured unavoidable projection/command work to its total. Cache miss/hit samples remain supplemental and are excluded from the comparable workload.

storage_bytes.reason: Prepared-state storage is not implemented; the bounded estimate is recorded separately.

io_operations.reason: Persisted prepared-state I/O does not exist before implementation; the bounded estimate is recorded separately.

allocated_bytes.reason: Prepared-state allocation is not isolated; the bounded estimate is recorded separately.

peak_managed_memory.reason: Prepared-state memory is not isolated; the bounded estimate is recorded separately.

storage_bound.basis: Deterministic workload-record envelope plus the largest representative profile payload; this is a pre-implementation serialized-state proxy.
storage_bound.uncertainty: 16-256 bytes per deterministic record and 0.25x-4x profile payload; replace with store instrumentation before implementation.

io_operations_bound.basis: One persisted write and one authorization/read minimum, with one metadata/read allowance per representative consumer.
io_operations_bound.uncertainty: The range covers one write plus one-to-two read/metadata operations per consumer until the store protocol is selected.

allocated_bytes_bound.basis: Serialized-state envelope with one additional encode/decode working copy.
allocated_bytes_bound.uncertainty: One-to-two state copies; implementation must replace this proxy with allocation measurement.

peak_managed_memory_bound.uncertainty: One-to-two state copies; excludes unrelated host memory and requires implementation instrumentation.

prepared_effect.scale_evidence_basis: Measured analysis-profile/v1 counters for small, medium, and large StagedAssemblies workloads; each point runs one cache-disabled process for every representative command family (strict, audit, no_new_debt, architecture_health, change_snapshot, topology, measure) and separately measures its strict/audit projection counters as the scale-specific load/authorization proxy.

scale_evidence.label: small
scale_evidence.measurement_basis: Measured analysis-profile/v1 counters from one cache-disabled CLI process per command family plus scale-specific strict/audit projection counters for the load/authorization proxy.

scale_evidence.label: medium
scale_evidence.measurement_basis: Measured analysis-profile/v1 counters from one cache-disabled CLI process per command family plus scale-specific strict/audit projection counters for the load/authorization proxy.

scale_evidence.label: large
scale_evidence.measurement_basis: Measured analysis-profile/v1 counters from one cache-disabled CLI process per command family plus scale-specific strict/audit projection counters for the load/authorization proxy.

expected_effect.current_work_model: R x independent candidate preparation/fact work
expected_effect.target_work_model: one cold preparation + R x load/authorization + unavoidable projection/command work
expected_effect.memory_allocation_trade_off: Direct storage, I/O, allocation, and peak-memory measurements remain unavailable; bounded pre-implementation sensitivity ranges are recorded and must be replaced by store instrumentation.
expected_effect.cold_path_trade_off: The cold preparation remains a separate cost and is never counted as a cache hit.
expected_effect.success_threshold: Only authorize implementation when persisted reuse is at least 10% cheaper than the measured representative one-process alternative, the measured small/medium/large matrix is decision-capable, and resource bounds are available.
expected_effect.kill_criterion: Defer or route elsewhere when canonical equivalence, cache separation, or a representative crossover is not reproduced.
expected_effect.confidence: Expected effect and small/medium/large scaling are derived from measured analysis-profile counters; each scale point has a separately measured strict/audit load/authorization proxy, while the persisted store remains an explicit pre-implementation proxy.

decision.reason: The complete one-process alternative was measured, but persisted reuse is not materially cheaper (27.3 % savings versus a 10.0 % threshold), its work is no more expensive, or the load-cost range removes a strict representative crossover.
